values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/meadowbrook-public-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=618 (banner: same-day until 5pm, 'Walk-ins will not be permitted'; 'up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; LENGTH OF STAY), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 618 (all pages, 2026-10-20): all 58 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'

values.note: DEC says 62 campsites; ReserveAmerica lists 58 campsites and a group camp, all back-in. Equipment lengths where listed are 20 ft (15 sites) or 30 ft (9 sites); 35 sites list none.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/meadowbrook-campground-and-day-use-area ('62 campsites') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 618 (all pages, 2026-10-20)

facilities.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/meadowbrook-campground-and-day-use-area ('hot showers, flush toilets, trailer dump station') + ReserveAmerica amenities (Water Fillup Station, Water Spigot), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $18 + $5 non-resident (DEC page), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max. Added same-day until 5 pm, no walk-ins, no electric (catalog), 62 sites, back-in only, listed lengths to 30 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump/water fill. Season left alone (manual today) but see flag. Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
flags: Season note is out of date: it says 'DEC posts no later date', but DEC's Meadowbrook page gives a closing date of September 7 (and opening May 15) for the current 2026 season. The 2027 ReserveAmerica schedule (the season's source) stops at Sep 5, 2027. A human may want closes '09-07' with a note that the dates are DEC's 2026 ones.
